results.content:
### Combine Tags

Want something more specific? Combine multiple tags to refine your search. For instance, if you’re looking for product pages that include illustrations, add both tags — “Product Page & Landing” and “Illustration” — and you’re there.

### Search by Text Content

Not everything is tagged — and that’s okay. You can also search by text. Type in any keyword or phrase, like “Airbnb login”, and Refero will pull up relevant screenshots instantly.

### Search by Site [...] ### Search by Site

Looking for inspiration from a specific brand or website? Just type the company name or web address — for example, “Notion” — to browse screenshots directly from that site.

### Switch Between Web & iOS

Easily toggle between Web and iOS views to explore how top designers craft experiences across platforms. Many tags work across both, so one click reveals a whole new perspective.

### Start Exploring [...] Loading Website

Refero is a beautifully curated design inspiration library built for UI/UX designers, showcasing top-tier web interfaces, landing pages, dashboards, and mobile apps.

It’s clean, fast, and focused on helping creatives find references without the noise.
